method: Group Git tree blob entries by exact Git blob SHA. This is byte-identity only; it does not establish semantic duplication or justify deletion.
limitations: Tree response is GitHub's recursive tree snapshot for the audited commit.
A matching blob can be intentional (e.g. templates, package markers, identical tile payloads, or public mirrors).
Content-level/geospatial validation is required before classifying repeated 3D Tiles payloads as erroneous.
The inventory does not inspect untracked files, build outputs outside Git, external services, or live runtime data.
